body: A first aid kit and water bottle are tied together. Blue powder coats one side and has caked into the bottle's threads. A few shriveled seedlings are stuck in it.
title: First aid kit and water bottle

body: A map and a pencil are kept together in a pocket. Three homes are circled, but only one is crossed off. I think the mark was made before the door was forced.
title: Map and pencil
